verdict.rationale: Replit lets users add AI/LLM integrations (e.g., OpenAI) and connects Agent to services via MCP or a curated integrations catalog with keys/OAuth provisioned automatically by Agent, so the user never manually manages provider keys. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation that LLM provider keys specifically (vs. general OAuth integrations) are fully auto-managed, and no detail on how usage/billing for third-party LLM calls is handled.
